notes.title: Cats & Cups Demo – Patch Notes v0.8.5
notes.content:
New Features & Systems

 Bakery Supply & Buy/Unlock system implemented
 Day Manager & Machine Shop custom camera position updates
 Customer drink, croissant, and order check systems expanded and refined
 Tutorial improvements with CupSpawner, tray, and UI warnings

Bug Fixes

 Fixed coffee grinder & customer issues
 Fixed croissant data, drink data, and ingredient localization failsafes
 Bakery shop tooltip & target position fixes
 Multiple order check & customer pointer bugs resolved
 Tutorial bugs and tray/cup position issues fixed
 Various small bugfixes for dough, butter, and ingredient shop

UI & UX Updates

 Icon pop-ups and new game warning panel refreshed
 Pop-up warnings, UI texts, and tables updated for consistency
 Improved customer warning texts & debug console commands
 Dragging & hover animations polished

Balancing & Data Updates

 Bakery shop prices adjusted
 Ingredient spawner & translations updated
 Fail-safes added for smoother demo stability


Enjoying the demo? 🐾☕

notes.title: Cats & Cups Demo – Patch Notes v0.8.2
notes.content:
Your café just got a little cozier! This update focuses on fixing bugs, polishing mini-games, and making your kitty café smoother to run.  

✨ New & Improved  
- Added Blender machine (unlockable in demo)  
- Upgraded Bakery & Oven animations (mini oven, dough cutting, croissant baking)  
- Milk & Coffee machines now have proper refill systems with warning pop-ups  
- New supply manager system to better track your stock  
- Tutorial updates: skip main tutorial option + smoother progression  
- Tooltip updates for ingredient shop and upgrades  
- Recipe papers improved with clearer glow & customer indicators  
- New SFX: grinder, whipped cream, coins, oven, and more for extra café vibes  
- Journal drawer & recipe journal UI refinements  

🐛 Bug Fixes  
- Fixed ingredient & trashcan glitches  
- Resolved blender cup index bug  
- Coffee grinder mini-game bugfixes & animation tweaks  
- Fixed supply popup warnings and start supply issues  
- Espresso machine glow + collider fixes  
- Water & straw machine button collider fixes  
- Fixed cup stacking visuals and tooltip overlaps  
- Several tutorial bugs resolved (glitched steps, TV loops)  

🍵 Balancing & Quality of Life  
- Drink limit raised: 5 → 10 per stack  
- Clearer low supply warnings at day end  
- Adjusted cup prices & amounts for smoother early game flow  
- Improved machine upgrade UI & tooltips  
- Camera control tweaks for bakery/shop scenes  

That’s all for this update — thank you for playing and sharing feedback! 💌  
If you tried the demo earlier, give it another go — things should feel smoother and more balanced now. ☕🐱

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521410/Cats__Cups/
